audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 2, 3 and 5 read Yone while their own why text says 'your first real punish window', 'You out-waveclear and out-poke', and 'your spike outpaces his first item'. breakdown.mid says 'This is your lane' and 'late' opens 'You owned every lane stage'. Row 0 reads Neeko while whys[0] says to concede it. The diff enum also says EVEN while diffRating and breakdown.difficulty say hard 8/10.
audit.why: Packet chart is [Skill, Neeko, Neeko, Neeko, Neeko, Neeko, Yone] and the win rate is 72.41% over 29 games, on 1410 slice games. Every prose line agrees with the packet, not with the chart.
audit.corrected: Row 0 to Skill, rows 1-5 to Neeko, row 6 stays Yone — one atomic pair-matched group — and the difficulty enums brought down to EVEN 6/10 with carry threat 7.5/10 so the rating stops contradicting the page.

audit.why: Four spikes correctly staged: Lvl 3 Q+E, Lvl 6 Pop Blossom, 1st item Liandry's/Blackfire, 2+ items his crit core. The 2+ item hand-off is real — Soul Unbound falls from 22s to 10s by rank 5, so his escape is effectively always up by then.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three separate mechanical errors: Yone's E is called 'Spirit Rewind' (its real name is Soul Unbound), it is described as having 'two E charges' (it has none — one cast on 22/19/16/13/10s), and his R is repeatedly called a knockup.
audit.why: Riot on R (Fate Sealed): 'Yone blinks behind the last champion in a line with a slash so powerful it pulls all enemies hit towards him' — a pull, and the kit flags it dash-only with no knockup. The knockup in his kit is Mortal Steel (Q) at 2 stacks. Separately, Spirit Cleave (W) grants Yone a shield scaling with champions hit on a 14s cooldown — that shield is what eats your burst window and it is never mentioned anywhere on the page.
audit.corrected: Real names used, the invented E charges removed, the R described as a pull, and the W shield stated as the thing that changes the all-in maths.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page calls Soul Unbound the matchup-defining cooldown and never says what it is.
audit.why: Soul Unbound is 22/19/16/13/10s. At rank 1 that is a 22-second window in which he cannot rewind out of your root — the concrete reason Level 3 through 5 belong to you, and the reason the late game does not.
audit.corrected: 22s stated in whys[3] and the mid text.

edits.before: This is your lane. Your Q waveclear shoves faster than his, and at 6 Pop Blossom flips a landed E into a kill — set the ult up while disguised or invisible from W so he can't pre-rewind out of the channel. Bait his E (Spirit Rewind) escape by forcing a trade with your clone, then commit the real combo once it's down. He has no answer to your root-into-stun while he's missing his dash.
edits.after: This is your lane. Your Q waveclear shoves faster than his, and at 6 Pop Blossom flips a landed E into a kill — set the ult up while disguised or invisible from W so he can't rewind out of the channel. Bait Soul Unbound (E) by forcing a trade with your clone, then commit the real combo inside its 22s downtime. He has no answer to root-into-stun while his dash is spent.

notes: Chart rows 0-5 proposed as one atomic pair-matched group. Three genuine kit errors fixed: 'Spirit Rewind' is not an ability (it is Soul Unbound), Yone's E has no charges, and Fate Sealed pulls rather than knocks up (the knockup is Mortal Steel at 2 stacks). Added the previously absent Spirit Cleave shield, which is the reason a burst rotation into a full-health Yone underperforms. Two strings still carry the old errors but did not fit the length band cleanly and are worth a second pass: content 'late' ('two E charges and his R knockup') and whys[6] (same). Unverified champion-wide and left alone: 'W invisibility' in mid, spikes[1] and wants.you[1] — Riot's W text gives a clone plus bonus damage and move speed, no stealth flag.
